title: Get to know Business Setup: Patient Groups, Provider Groups and more
summary: Tour of Patient Groups, Provider Groups, Templates, Medical Instruction Templates and Prescription Templates: what each screen is for.

steps.title: Business Setup
steps.details: We'll go through Patient Groups, Provider Groups, Templates, Medical Instruction Templates and Prescription Templates.

steps.title: Patient Groups
steps.details: They group patients (agreements, campaigns, families) to filter them, apply conditions and export them. It has 5 guides in «Guide me on this screen».

steps.title: Provider Groups
steps.details: They group providers to organize purchases and expense reports. It has 5 guides in «Guide me on this screen».

steps.title: Templates
steps.details: The design of the documents that are printed or sent: quotes, invoices, payments and credit notes. It has 1 guide in «Guide me on this screen».

steps.title: Menu → Business Setup → Medical Instruction Templates
Medical Instruction Templates
steps.details: Predefined texts (post-op care, preparation for tests) given to the patient from their clinical history. It has 4 guides in «Guide me on this screen».

steps.title: Prescription Templates
steps.details: The format of the prescriptions doctors issue: letterhead, body and signature. It has 4 guides in «Guide me on this screen».
